title: New AC on-board charger upgrade for the Porsche Taycan (Porsche newsroom US, 2022)
notes: 19.2 kW charger kit (KB4 option / retrofit) for all Taycan variants, 0-100% in 4.8 h vs 9.5 h with the previous charger. Does not state the previous charger in kW (9.5 h for the pack implies about half of 19.2).
